title: Certify the F-star one-interior-label gap on tied_min
body:
## Summary

```text
Each of twelve tied_min v=11 restrictions:
  Form-R with unrestricted ordering       maximum 10
  Add one (111,e_c) pair                  attain 11
```

Close the constructive label-kind handoff in [PR2963 open question 2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2963), and the full v=12 fixture's open Form-R question from PR2914. The minimum number of non-Form-R pairs in an eleven-line witness is exactly one. This is an exact finite result, not a general F-star theorem, physical decoder or kappa improvement.

Only `research/fstar-one-interior-label/` is added. It contains the written recurrence argument, two separately implemented exact exclusions, all twelve constructive orders and registered controls. No predecessor executable is imported. The only live scientific input is the SHA256-pinned fixture already on main.

## Evidence

- Before, the Form-R eleven-line question was open in PR2914 and the retained review; PR2963 requested a constructive account of the gap. After, every restriction has an exhaustive Form-R exclusion plus a ten-line Form-R witness and an eleven-line one-exception witness.
- Forward b-domain and reverse a-domain searches exhaust 2,455 and 888 states respectively per exclusion. Witnesses check support, diagonal parity and every ordered rational-zero constraint. No recorded CP-SAT optimum is required.
- Registered Python 3.12.15 replay and all seven behavioral groups pass. Python 3.13.5 normal/optimized checks pass. All 147 research-workflow tests pass on Python 3.12 with no skips. Literal tiny oracles, actual weakened implementations, capacity/source/receipt/CLI controls, Ruff and exact committed-byte preflight pass.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fstar-one-interior-label
```

Scientific base `916ecdd9d6e666fcad9b25369d055311f6ce8204`; refreshed branch base `a23bdc1b07be96bea0101d44ae27d14de67a79ed`, priority 5. Consumed input, guidance and selected record are unchanged. Exact source pins and coverage are in TASK/SOURCES. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2967).

Credit Aaron Wang/PR2963 for the handoff, PR2914 for the label ladder and retained certificate lineage, and DreamingOfClouds/PR2111/PR1590 for the fixture and L8 definition. Full predecessor credit and Apache-2.0 scope remain in the package.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package.

No shared code, frozen evidence or selected frontier changes. General ordering rules, native realization, restoration, hosting, precision and complete recursive costs remain open. The reported predecessor `named=9` value is context, not newly audited. No independent human, formal-kernel or hosted-CI success is claimed.
